add_member_to_audience.description: Add a contact to a Mailchimp audience, or update them if they are already in it, so it is safe to run every time the same person signs up, buys or donates again. A contact already there keeps their subscription status (someone who unsubscribed stays unsubscribed), gets the names given, and has the tags given added; nothing is removed. 'created' says whether they were new.

parameters.name: email

parameters.name: status

parameters.description: First name
parameters.name: first_name

parameters.description: Last name
parameters.name: last_name

parameters.description: Beta. Tags to put on the contact, such as Webinar or monthly, so no separate tagging step is needed. A new contact is added with them; a contact already in the audience has them added to the tags they have, and none of their tags is removed. A tag that doesn't exist yet is created.
parameters.name: tags

created.description: (beta) True if the contact was new to the audience, false if they were already in it and were updated

description: Manage your Mailchimp audiences, members, and email campaigns.

mailchimp_campaign_sent_trigger.description: Runs each time a Mailchimp email campaign is sent, with its name, subject, how many it went to and its public link. Campaigns sent before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.archive_url: The public link to the campaign as sent.
output.id: The campaign's ID, for later Mailchimp steps.
output.list_id: The ID of the audience it went to.
output.subject: Its subject line.
output.title: The campaign's name.

mailchimp_member_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a contact is added to a Mailchimp audience or their details change (a name, a field, their status), with their email, name, status and tags. Changes from before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.first_name: Their first name, if the audience has one for them.
output.full_name: Their full name, as Mailchimp shows it.
output.last_name: Their last name, if the audience has one for them.
output.merge_fields: Every audience field for them (FNAME, LNAME and the rest).
output.status: subscribed, unsubscribed, pending, cleaned or archived.
output.unsubscribe_reason: Why they left, if they said.

parameters.description: The audience to watch. Pick one, or give its ID.
parameters.name: list_id

mailchimp_member_tagged_trigger.description: Runs each time a subscriber in a Mailchimp audience is given a tag, such as Webinar, with their email, name and tags. People who already have the tag when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Watches tags of up to 4,000 people. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.first_name: Their first name, if the audience has one for them.
output.full_name: Their full name, as Mailchimp shows it.
output.last_name: Their last name, if the audience has one for them.
output.merge_fields: Every audience field for them (FNAME, LNAME and the rest).
output.status: subscribed, unsubscribed, pending, cleaned or archived.
output.unsubscribe_reason: Why they left, if they said.

parameters.description: The audience to watch. Pick one, or give its ID.
parameters.name: list_id

parameters.description: The tag's name, as Mailchimp shows it under Audience > Tags.
parameters.name: tag_name

mailchimp_new_subscriber_trigger.description: Runs for each new subscriber to a Mailchimp audience, with their email, name and tags. Subscribers already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.first_name: Their first name, if the audience has one for them.
output.full_name: Their full name, as Mailchimp shows it.
output.last_name: Their last name, if the audience has one for them.
output.merge_fields: Every audience field for them (FNAME, LNAME and the rest).
output.status: subscribed, unsubscribed, pending, cleaned or archived.
output.unsubscribe_reason: Why they left, if they said.

parameters.description: The audience to watch. Pick one, or give its ID.
parameters.name: list_id

mailchimp_unsubscribed_trigger.description: Runs each time someone unsubscribes from a Mailchimp audience, with their email, name and the reason they gave. Unsubscribes from before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.first_name: Their first name, if the audience has one for them.
output.full_name: Their full name, as Mailchimp shows it.
output.last_name: Their last name, if the audience has one for them.
output.merge_fields: Every audience field for them (FNAME, LNAME and the rest).
output.status: subscribed, unsubscribed, pending, cleaned or archived.
output.unsubscribe_reason: Why they left, if they said.

parameters.description: The audience to watch. Pick one, or give its ID.
parameters.name: list_id
